title: ochna obtusata var. pumila
intro: Ochna obtusata var. pumila, commonly known as the Dwarf Mussaenda, is a small shrub-like plant belonging to the Ochnaceae family. Traditionally, it has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, owing to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ochna obtusata var. pumila include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
